# 高价值矿产目标 / High-Value Mining Targets

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:138 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链定义 mineral_planet_chain（common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:138）。在随游戏发行的全部文件中，没有任何脚本对它执行 begin_event_chain，也没有任何事件、特殊项目或 on_action 引用它的名称，因此玩家在正常游戏中不会看到这条事件链。

Event-chain definition mineral_planet_chain (common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:138). In all files shipped with the game no script runs begin_event_chain for it and no event, special project or on_action mentions its name, so the chain never appears in normal play.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

日志文本“高价值采矿目标”（根据古代采矿无人机的评估技术找出的几处富矿天体）；计数器 systems_visited 上限5。

Log text "High-Value Mining Targets" (stellar bodies found with the ancient mining drones' assessment techniques); counter systems_visited, max 5.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

本导读未单列分支与结局；分支随各事件在上文说明，互斥结果在阅读器中以“择一”框显示。/ This guide does not list branches separately; they are described with each event above, and exclusive outcomes are boxed in the reader.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
